description.text: The path to a 3D file to import. Note that only Alembic files will be localised.

Allow local file caching. Copies of the files are stored in a specified local folder for faster access times.

on: always localize
fromAutoLocalizePath: localize if the file resides in the "auto-localize from" directory
onDemand: localize on demand
off: never localize

If true, the following metadata fields can be promoted to the stage:
  • Start time code
  • End time code
  • Frames per second
  • Time codes per second
  • Frame precision
  • Meters per unit
  • Default prim
  • Up axis
  • Owner
  • Custom layer metadata
Note that if multiple layers specify a value, the strongest opinion is used.
Frame Range

If range size is non-zero then animation is assumed to be contained in the input file data, forcing the graph to re-evaluate on frame changes. If the input file is known to be static then resetting these to 1..1 stop this graph updating.
